The official 2026 pricing schedule, effective June 1, 2026, fully supersedes the deprecated 2025 pricing proposal and is the sole source of truth for sales, renewals, and audits [NL-003#NL-003-S01][NL-003#NL-003-S08].

Comparison of plan rates and onboarding fees:

- **Starter Plan**: Deprecated 2025: $900/month with a $1,500 onboarding fee [NL-004#NL-004-S02]. Official 2026: $1,200/month with a $2,500 onboarding fee, adjusted to cover automated ingestion resources [NL-004#NL-004-S05].
- **Growth Plan**: Deprecated 2025: $2,800/month with a $4,500 onboarding fee [NL-004#NL-004-S02]. Official 2026: $3,600/month with a $7,500 onboarding fee, adjusted for dedicated implementation specialist support and SSO setup [NL-004#NL-004-S05].
- **Enterprise Plan**: Deprecated 2025: starting at $6,000/month with onboarding from $10,000 [NL-004#NL-004-S02]. Official 2026: starting at $8,500/month with onboarding of at least $15,000, adjusted for custom Okta/AD permission mapping and advanced OCR pipeline setup [NL-004#NL-004-S05].

The 2025 proposal was rejected because early cost assumptions were financially unsustainable; actual Q1 2026 pilot costs were materially higher than projected across LLM inference, vector storage, OCR ingestion, directory sync, and support engineering [NL-004#NL-004-S04]. Legacy contracts may run out their current term but must migrate to the 2026 rates upon renewal [NL-004#NL-004-S05][NL-003#NL-003-S08]. A one-time 90-day grace period at a mid-tier rate (e.g., $3,100/month for Growth instead of $3,600) may be offered for qualifying accounts, subject to CSM request and VP of Customer Success approval [NL-003#NL-003-S08].
